answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by making earnings vest and be forfeitable: a newcomer's rewards unlock slowly, like nectar gathered at dawn, and are lost entirely if its work is later shown to be coordinated copy-farming. A saffron thread of pending pay ties each identity to honest behaviour, because a farm that spawns thousands of copies risks forfeiting every pending payout at once, while a single honest agent simply waits out its vesting and keeps what it earned.
